subject: Follow-up: discovery recap + proposed heartbeat windows for technical deep-dive
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alicia Gomez <agomez@orionhealth.com>, Tom Reynolds <tom@orionhealth.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Feb 2028 16:12:00 -0800
Subject: Follow-up: discovery recap + proposed heartbeat windows for technical deep-dive

Hi Alicia / Tom —

Great to meet earlier — thanks for the context on the integration surface and the two main priorities you called out (data residency & predictable latency for charting). Quick recap and next steps so we keep momentum: 

Summary from today
- Primary goal: validate architecture for embedding patient records and prototype a 45-min technical deep-dive that includes integration patterns and a short ops/retention Q&A.
- Key constraints: SOC2 evidence for audit, Kafka-based ingestion (daily batches), and a 6-month sandbox retention for POC.
- Success metric for POC: <200ms median gen latency for 512-token requests during test load.

Proposed "heartbeat" windows (rotating weekly so distributed teams can join):
- Week A (US-friendly): 08:00–10:00 PT (15:00–17:00 UTC) — good for your West Coast engineers
- Week B (EU-friendly): 14:00–16:00 UTC — easy for your London/Frankfurt folks
- Week C (APAC-friendly): 23:00–01:00 UTC (late APAC morning) — covers Sydney/Seoul mornings

How the cadence would work
- We run the first deep-dive in whichever window you prefer, then rotate windows weekly (A → B → C) for follow-ups so no single team bears all the off-hours.

Two asks for you:
1) Which window would you prefer for the first session? (I suggest Week B / EU window since Tom called out EU folks being primary stakeholders.)
2) Who should be the technical lead on your side for the deep-dive (name + email) so we can loop them into the calendar invite and the runbook?

I attached a small ICS with the candidate slots and my discovery notes. We’re happy to compress the agenda to 45 minutes if you need to keep it tight (integration + retention + Q&A).

Proposed first slot (pick one):
- Thu Feb 24, 2028 — 15:00–15:45 UTC (EU window)
- Tue Feb 22, 2028 — 08:30–09:15 PT (US window)
- Wed Feb 23, 2028 — 23:30–00:15 UTC (APAC window)

If any of those work I’ll lock it and send a calendar invite with goals + prep notes.

Thanks again — excited to keep this moving.

Best,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0198
Redwood Inference

Attachments: proposed_heartbeat_windows.ics, discovery-notes.pdf

From: Alicia Gomez <agomez@orionhealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Reynolds <tom@orionhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Feb 2028 09:03:00 +00:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: discovery recap + proposed heartbeat windows for technical deep-dive

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the clear recap — that matches our notes. Short answers below: 

- Preference for first session: EU window (Thu Feb 24 at 15:00 UTC) works best for our product and infra leads.
- Technical lead: Tom Reynolds (tom@orionhealth.com) will own the session and invite the infra engineer (he’ll share the exact person by EOD Friday).
- Agenda length: please compress to 45 minutes. We want a focused run-through (integration touchpoints + data retention + a quick checklist for SOC2 evidence).

A couple of asks on our side before the session:
1) Can you include a brief slide or one-pager about typical retention strategies and audit log formats you support?
2) Confirm any minimal sandbox data requirements (sample size, PII handling).

If it helps, Tom and I are generally available Tues/Thurs afternoons in Feb — so the proposed Thu 24 slot looks good.

Cheers,
Alicia
Head of Partnerships | Orion Health
agomez@orionhealth.com

Date: Wed, 15 Feb 2028 10:40:00 -0800
Subject: FW: Follow-up: discovery recap + proposed heartbeat windows for technical deep-dive

Team — quick internal note after Alicia confirmed EU window for the first session. Key asks from the prospect: 
- Compress to 45 minutes and focus on integration + retention + evidence for SOC2.
- They want a one-pager on retention strategies and minimal sandbox requirements.

Dev — can you draft the 1-pager (1 page PDF) and a 3-slide technical runbook that highlights:
  * ingestion (Kafka daily batches),
  * how we handle PII in sandbox mode (masking/encryption), and
  * what we can produce as audit evidence (token logs, access logs, model versioning).

Ben — heads-up: they asked about audit evidence; if we need to offer any concessions (extended trial retention for the POC) we may want to confirm margin flexibility.

I’ll lock the calendar after Dev shares the runbook.

Thanks,
Marissa

From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Feb 2028 13:05:00 -0500
Subject: Re: FW: Follow-up: discovery recap + proposed heartbeat windows for technical deep-dive

Thanks — I’ll put together the one-pager and the 3-slide runbook. Plan:
- One-pager: retention options (7/30/180 day presets), masking + encryption, and what we can export for audit (S3 logs, per-request metadata).
- Runbook: 3 slides — architecture sketch, sample API calls and config snippet, checklist for what we need from Orion (sample data shapes, service accounts, expected throughput).

I’ll upload the PDFs to the shared folder and attach the runbook to the invite once ready. Suggest we confirm the Thu Feb 24, 15:00–15:45 UTC slot and assign me as the primary SE on the invite.

Attaching draft: demo-runbook.pdf (v0.1) — attaching as a stub here.
